blocks.html: The input for setting a layout configuration for a zone.

types.name: zone
types.description: The zone that the layout configuration applies to.

types.name: user_id
types.description: The ID of the user that the layout configuration belongs to.

types.name: is_default
types.description:
Whether to set the configuration as the system default for the zone,
rather than the user's personal configuration.

types.name: configuration
types.description: The layout configuration data to set.

children.name: widgets
children.description: Per-widget placement and visibility preferences, keyed by widget ID.

children.name: section
children.description: Override which section this widget appears in.

children.name: order
children.description: Override the sort order of the widget within its section.
